title: GraphExecutionManifest
description: Schema for token-budgeted, deterministic execution graphs (DAGs) compiled by graph-planner and consumed by graph-execution.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the manifest schema contract.

version.description: Semantic version of the graph definition.

caller.description: Opaque metadata or trace information supplied by caller environment.

token_ceiling_total.description: Advisory token budget ceiling allocated across all graph nodes.

max_parallel_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent parallel workers allowed during fan-out.

max_retries_per_node.description: Maximum retry attempts before triggering failure escalation (max 2 retries = 3 attempts total).

role.description: Functional role of node. 'approval' identifies leading approval verifier_gate.

tier.description: Compute tier assigned based on token economics.

command_or_eval.description: Executable bash command, verifier script, or prompt spec.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution time in seconds before terminating node process.

verifier_hash.description: Expected SHA256 hex digest of verifier script or command.

mutation_targets.description: Explicit relative file paths this mutation node is permitted to modify.

forbidden_paths.description: Glob patterns that this mutation node must never modify.

reversible.description: Whether mutations or actions by this node can be undone via git rollback. External network/API calls must set false.

input_bindings.description: Upstream node outputs bound as inputs.

oneOf.description: Path to schema JSON or format descriptor defining node output.
Inline JSON schema object defining node output contract.

output_contract.description: Output validation contract as an on-disk schema path or an inline JSON schema object.

depends_on.description: IDs of prerequisite nodes that must complete before this node executes.

failure_escalation.description: Action taken when node execution or verification exhausts all retries.

fallback_node_id.description: Target fallback node ID required when failure_escalation is fallback_node.
